Ketamine
Last May, my friends and I decided to get a vile of ketamine.  This was are second time buying a vial and decided this time we would go all out.  Reading about possible hallocianations on ketamine with a large dose I immediatly decieded I wanted to try that.  One bump for us is supposed to last 45 minutes but I decided to do 4 in 10 minutes.  After that I dont really remember much.  I went upstairs to clean the guts off my table after just rolling a blunt.  When I looked at the table it all seemed to overwhleming so I decided to close my eyes.  After what seemed to be a minute the table was all clean and my friend was yelling we gotta get out of ur house your parents are gonna be home soon.  I immediatly new something was wrong and I had over done my limits.  All my negative thoughts in my head were just pooring out I coudlnt control anything my body was doing like if I thought of something I had to say it I had no control.  After walking about 90 feet away from my house I fell down in the middle of the road cuase I just couldnt walk anymore.  I was slurring my words, couldnt feel my legs and just fell.  A few moments later I got up and walked another 90 feet then just completely threw up all over my street and I could see myself throwing up from like an outside veiwer.  For the next 20 mintures I layed on the side of my street in complete misery.  I wanted to be normal death seemed arite I didndt care I just wanted to be normal.  I finally got up and walked to my destination and smoked the sickest blunt I've ever rolled.  Things on K just seem so much longer and a long lasting blunt fixed everything.  I later did k again that nite but I didnt get in a k hole this time.
